limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter but also let the module accept up to three more inputs while an output was stalled, whereas the original and reference deassert `ready_a` for the entire stall.
The separate partial-sum register made `data_out` update only on the fourth accepted input, replacing the reference's per-input updates and its `ready_b`-dependent rule for starting a new sum.
The test treated the new buffering policy as correct and checked `data_out` only when a result was pending, so its pass did not verify that the original handshake and output behavior were preserved.
